## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npx vitest run` pass
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` for a visible change
- [ ] Interface texts in the five languages (`src/i18n/`)
- [ ] Exported films unchanged, or the change says how and why
